@graph.name: TRFCleanflow
@graph.description: TRFCleanflow is the sanitary conveyor systems platform of TRF Industrial Automation, built to move exposed food between processing, inspection and packaging, in a Dry line for low-moisture areas and a Washdown line for high-pressure, high-temperature cleaning.

mainEntity.name: Can a Conveyor System Be Designed for Both Dry and Washdown Zones in the Same Plant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A plant can have a wet processing area washed every day and a dry packaging area cleaned without water. TRF engineers TRFCleanflow Dry for low-moisture areas and TRFCleanflow Washdown for frequent, high-pressure cleaning within one project, and defines during engineering where construction changes, how the boundary is cleaned and how the flow continues into packaging and case handling.

mainEntity.name: How Much Does a Stainless Steel Conveyor Cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the product and its condition, the line selected for each zone, conveyor length, inclines and transfers, belt type, stainless grade, drives and controls, and the sanitation routine the line must support. TRFCleanflow is always quoted as a complete engineered system, so a TRF Sales Engineer defines the scope from your product, layout and cleaning program.

mainEntity.name: Can a Single Supplier Engineer, Build and Install My Entire Conveyor System?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRFCleanflow projects are delivered turnkey: one partner is responsible for engineering, manufacturing, controls, installation and commissioning. TRF also supplies TRFIntraflow for packaged goods, plus case packing and palletizing, so a plant can have one design and one partner from the processing room to the finished pallet. Each project is scoped from your product, layout and sanitation program.
